label: Evelyn's place
blurb: A cheap studio, basement or 1BR for Evelyn on her own — under 20 minutes from Matt's and from work.

anchors.label: Niece — 575 Allgair Ave, North Brunswick, NJ
Once Upon A Child — 561 US-1, Edison, NJ

kinds.label: Basement / in-law unit
checklist: Ask to see the Certificate of Occupancy — in NJ a basement unit is only legal with one
Second way out (egress window or door) besides the main stairs?
Ceiling height and window size — does it feel like a legal bedroom?
Is the rent all-in or are utilities extra?

listings.name: 45 Bristol Road
listings.pros: Cheapest self-contained unit found on the browser sources. Own studio unit, not a room. Close to major highways, shops and restaurants.
listings.cons: Tenant pays all utilities. No central AC — listing says bring your own window units. Driveway shared with two other apartments. Niece drive is right at the 15-minute cap.
listings.notes: niece 15m · work 17m · home 22m (OSRM free-flow). Also listed on HotPads (/45-bristol-road-piscataway-nj-08854-1jahus3/). Listing text: "cozy studio in Piscataway... The driveway is shared with two other apartments. Tenants are responsible for all utilities. Tenants can bring their own window AC units."

listings.name: Tov Manor
listings.pros: Managed apartment community with on-site management, not a private-landlord room. Best commute numbers of any keeper. Pet-friendly, shared laundry, central air, covered parking. 2 units available at the time of the sweep.
listings.cons: Only $100 under the hard cap. Building rents run 1-2BR ($1,300-$1,860), so the $1,300 is the entry price and may not be the unit that is actually free. Square footage not published.
listings.notes: niece 6m · work 7m · home 10m (OSRM free-flow). Cross-listed on HotPads (/tov-manor-new-brunswick-nj-08901-sm7jq2/) at the same $1,300+ entry price; HotPads shows 2 units available. Phone on HotPads: 732-719-7672.

listings.name: SoCam290 — 1x1 Standard
listings.pros: 680 sq ft for $1,310 — much the largest keeper per dollar, and a whole self-contained 1BR/1BA (the 1x1 Standard floor plan). 3 units available. In-unit washer/dryer, dishwasher, A/C, hardwood, granite, elevator, controlled access, fitness center. Closest to the niece of every keeper (5 min).
listings.cons: Student-oriented building next to Rutgers — the 2x2 plan is advertised at $925 which is per-bed, so expect a young/student-heavy tenant mix and by-the-bed leasing culture. Tours by appointment only.
listings.notes: niece 5m · work 9m · home 13m (OSRM free-flow). Rent quoted is the 1x1 Standard whole-unit price (680 sq ft), NOT a per-bed price — confirm that on the call. 3 units available at sweep time. Phone: 732-641-6545.

listings.name: 29 S Adelaide Ave
listings.pros: Renovated studio — quartz counters, gas range, tile/vinyl floors, high ceilings, crown molding, walk-in closet, A/C, on-site laundry. 5-minute drive to New Brunswick NJ Transit; 6 min to the niece, 7 to work.
listings.cons: $2,195 deposit (1.6x the rent) is the highest of any keeper. Small — 350-450 sq ft. $25 under the hard cap, no headroom.
listings.notes: niece 6m · work 7m · home 13m (OSRM free-flow). Studio floor plan is 350-450 sq ft at $1,375; the building's other plan is a 2BR at $2,050. Deposit $2,195. Photos of the studio floor plan itself were listed as not available — gallery photos are building/common shots. Phone: 848-800-2144.

listings.name: Raritan Crossing Apartment Homes — THE BRUNSWICK
listings.pros: 560 sq ft studio in a real managed community — gated, on-site manager and maintenance, pool, fitness center, hardwood floors, walk-in closets, dishwasher, laundry facilities. Pet friendly. Commute is excellent in all three directions.
listings.cons: Exactly at the $1,400 cap — zero headroom, and community fees are likely on top. The studio is listed 'Available Soon', not now, so it may not be rentable on Evelyn's timeline.
listings.notes: niece 7m · work 7m · home 11m (OSRM free-flow). THE BRUNSWICK floor plan: studio, 1 bath, 560 sq ft, $1,400, status 'Available Soon' — ask for the actual availability date and whether the $1,400 is base rent before required fees.

listings.name: Clean Basement Apartment
listings.pros: Well within all three commute caps (niece 8m, work 13m, home 12m); own kitchen, living room and full bathroom; separate/private entrance mentioned; posted 1 day ago (fresh) with 8 photos advertised on-site (only 1 was recoverable without a browser)
listings.cons: No mention of Certificate of Occupancy or second egress; sqft (1000) seems large for a basement studio-style unit, worth confirming layout on a call
listings.notes: niece 8m · work 13m · home 12m (OSRM free-flow driving). Listing text: 'Very clean and quite neighborhood, one bedroom, one living room, kitchen with electric stove, microwave and fridge, plenty space, full bathroom, separate entrance.' Available from 01 Sep 2026. Source page advertises 8 photos but the search-results/detail HTML only exposes 1 real photo URL without executing Sulekha's photo-lightbox AJAX call (get-ad-photosv3.aspx) in a browser — ask for more photos when calling.

listings.pros: Self-contained 1BR/1BA condo, in-unit washer/dryer, water & sewer included, assigned parking, close to bus/train, no broker fee; excellent commute (niece 7m, work 12m, home 15m)
listings.cons: One-time $350 admin fee to the condo association on top of $995.50 security deposit; tenant pays gas & electric; this exact address has been reposted at least 3 times since 8/19 (may indicate slow turnover or repeated relisting) — confirm it's still available
listings.notes: niece 7m · work 12m · home 15m (OSRM free-flow driving from 706 North Oaks Blvd near Livingston Ave). Listing text: '706 North Oaks Blvd, North Brunswick, NJ 08902 - 1 Bdr, Lvr, kitchen, DR, 1bath specious condominium for the rent, unit ready to move in, washing & dryer in the unit, water & sewer included, during the Summer available pool, assigned parking, closed to bus, train Station, no pets, no smoking in the unit, no brokers fee, rent $995/month; Security Deposit $995.50; one time $350 admin fee to the condo Assoc.' Displayed listing price is $1,000 (rounded); body text quotes $995. Available now.

listings.name: Hermann Rd 1BR (2nd floor of 3-family)

listings.cons: Only one photo published and no exact street number (map pin is approximate, plotted near Hermann Rd/Georges Rd); tenant pays gas & electric; posted 8/8 — nearly a month old, confirm it hasn't been rented
